entry.typicalBarText: Early-career intake bar focuses on core CS fundamentals, data structures & algorithms problem-solving track record, competitive coding profiles (LeetCode/Codeforces), academic consistency (CGPA), and demonstrable projects or internship exposure. Non-CS candidates are expected to bridge core operating systems and networks coursework.
expectedSignals: Core CS fundamentals or degree coursework
Clear programming language proficiency with code samples or links

scoredSignals.label: Internships & Practical Training
scoredSignals.description: Formal internship, co-op, or industry training experience demonstrating collaborative codebase work.

scoredSignals.label: Competitive Coding & Platform Profiles
scoredSignals.description: Active coding profiles (LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, GitHub) demonstrating problem-solving persistence.

scoredSignals.label: Academic Performance & Coursework Consistency
scoredSignals.description: Documented CGPA, GPA, percentage, or academic honors reflecting academic rigor.

scoredSignals.label: Core CS Fundamentals & Branch Alignment
scoredSignals.description: Degree coursework or explicit coverage of Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, DBMS, and Computer Networks.

adviceCards.title: Add Formal Internship or Open-Source Experience
adviceCards.recommendation: Add formal internships, co-ops, or open-source fellowship contributions to validate collaborative delivery in production teams.

adviceCards.title: Link Verified Coding Profiles
adviceCards.recommendation: Link active competitive coding profiles (LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank) or GitHub with solved DSA problems to prove algorithmic mastery.

adviceCards.title: Highlight Core CS Fundamentals Coursework
adviceCards.recommendation: Non-CS engineering backgrounds must explicitly highlight core CS coursework (Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, DBMS, Networks) to pass technical screening.

adviceCards.title: Include Academic Record or Distinction
adviceCards.recommendation: List degree CGPA / aggregate percentage if above 7.0/10 (or 3.0/4.0); otherwise emphasize high-impact open source repositories and contest rankings.

junior.typicalBarText: Junior developer bar requires proven ability to contribute clean, tested code to production repositories, actively participate in code reviews, debug incidents with supervision, and operate basic CI/CD automation.
expectedSignals: Code review participation and debugging skills

scoredSignals.label: Production Codebase Contributions
scoredSignals.description: Shipped features, merged pull requests, and production deployment lifecycle contributions.

scoredSignals.label: Code Review & Root Cause Debugging
scoredSignals.description: Active participation in peer reviews, debugging defects, and resolving technical debt.

scoredSignals.label: Automated Testing & CI/CD Pipelines
scoredSignals.description: Unit testing suites and continuous integration pipeline automation.

scoredSignals.label: Agile Delivery & Team Collaboration
scoredSignals.description: Cross-functional sprint cadence, backlog prioritization, and iterative shipping.

adviceCards.title: Highlight Automated Test Coverage & CI/CD
adviceCards.recommendation: Highlight automated test coverage percentages and automated deployment pipeline experience in your bullets.

adviceCards.title: Cite Production Releases & Pull Requests
adviceCards.recommendation: Quantify features merged into production and release cycles to prove independent code contribution.

adviceCards.title: Document Defect Triage & Peer Reviews
adviceCards.recommendation: Include bullet points detailing how you diagnosed and resolved critical bugs or participated in peer code reviews.

mid.typicalBarText: Mid-level hiring bar requires independent subsystem ownership, proven track record scaling services or databases under load, operational on-call rotation experience, and proactive code mentorship for peers.
expectedSignals: Independent feature delivery and subsystem ownership
API design and database schema design

scoredSignals.label: Subsystem & Feature Ownership
scoredSignals.description: End-to-end design, implementation, and maintenance of critical business modules.

scoredSignals.label: Scalability, Concurrency & Data Volume
scoredSignals.description: Architecting for high QPS, low latency, caching strategies, and efficient database indexing.

scoredSignals.label: On-Call Rotations & Operational Reliability
scoredSignals.description: Production telemetry, incident response, monitoring dashboards, and SLA compliance.

scoredSignals.label: Technical Mentorship & Design Docs
scoredSignals.description: Authoring RFCs/design docs and mentoring junior developers on engineering practices.

adviceCards.title: Demonstrate End-to-End Subsystem Ownership
adviceCards.recommendation: Demonstrate autonomous end-to-end subsystem ownership rather than peripheral task-oriented ticket completion.

adviceCards.title: Quantify Scale, Throughput, and Concurrency
adviceCards.recommendation: Provide specific scale metrics (concurrent users, requests per second, database table sizes, cache hit ratios).

adviceCards.title: Highlight Operational Telemetry & On-Call
adviceCards.recommendation: Cite on-call responsibilities, system observability tools, or production incident recovery metrics to demonstrate operational maturity.

adviceCards.title: Showcase Peer Mentorship & RFC Authoring
adviceCards.recommendation: Highlight mentorship of junior peers or authoring engineering design docs (RFCs) to prove organizational value.

senior.typicalBarText: Senior engineer hiring bar demands comprehensive system architecture expertise, cross-team impact, active hiring loop participation, and direct alignment of technical deliverables with measurable business revenue or cost reduction.
expectedSignals: End-to-end system architecture and technical leadership
Cross-functional mentorship and design review standards
Operational excellence, scalability (QPS/p99), and reliability SLAs

scoredSignals.label: Distributed System Scope & Architecture
scoredSignals.description: High-level architecture, microservice boundaries, distributed data consistency, and zero-downtime migrations.

scoredSignals.label: Cross-Team Technical Influence
scoredSignals.description: Directing multi-team technical standards, shared internal platforms, and organizational engineering guidelines.

scoredSignals.label: Engineering Hiring & Talent Mentorship
scoredSignals.description: Conducting technical interview loops, training interviewers, and mentoring mid-level engineers toward promotion.

scoredSignals.label: Business Outcomes & Cost Optimization
scoredSignals.description: Driving cloud infrastructure cost reductions, customer retention, revenue enablement, and corporate SLAs.

adviceCards.title: Document Multi-Service Architectural Trade-offs
adviceCards.recommendation: Detail multi-service architectural trade-offs, fault tolerance mechanisms, and distributed consistency models you designed.

adviceCards.title: Highlight Cross-Team Technical Influence
adviceCards.recommendation: Showcase initiatives that influenced multiple engineering squads, platform libraries, or department standards.

adviceCards.title: Tie Architecture Directly to Business ROI
adviceCards.recommendation: Tie your engineering systems directly to executive metrics ($Xk saved in cloud infrastructure, conversion uplift, SLA guarantees).

adviceCards.title: Mention Hiring Loops & Team Growth
adviceCards.recommendation: Mention contributions to technical recruiting loops, hiring rubrics, and scaling high-performing engineering teams.

lead.typicalBarText: Lead and staff bar requires multi-team technical vision, company-wide architecture governance, strategic technology roadmaps, and direct partnership with executive leadership to de-risk high-stakes initiatives.
expectedSignals: Multi-team technical vision and strategic roadmapping
High-stakes organizational engineering impact and mentorship

scoredSignals.label: Multi-Team Technical Vision & Roadmaps
scoredSignals.description: Multi-quarter architectural vision aligning multiple engineering squads with company strategic goals.

scoredSignals.label: Architecture Governance & Risk Management
scoredSignals.description: Leading Architecture Review Boards (ARB), technology radar decisions, security postures, and disaster recovery.

scoredSignals.label: Executive Leadership & Business Translation
scoredSignals.description: Partnering with VP/CTO/C-Suite leaders to align technology investments with business strategy and capital allocation.

scoredSignals.label: Enterprise-Scale High-Availability Infrastructure
scoredSignals.description: Five-nines (99.999%) multi-region infrastructure reliability, latency SLAs, and mission-critical platform stability.

adviceCards.title: Articulate Multi-Team Strategic Roadmaps
adviceCards.recommendation: Demonstrate how your technical roadmaps guided 3+ engineering teams across multi-quarter strategic horizons.

adviceCards.title: Highlight C-Suite & Executive Alignment
adviceCards.recommendation: Highlight regular alignment with CTO/VP leadership on technology investments, organizational risk, and capital allocation.

adviceCards.title: Document Architectural Governance & ARB Leadership
adviceCards.recommendation: Document leadership of architecture review boards, engineering standards, or company-wide security postures.
